situation-room.pres-heading: Path to the presidency — on results counted so far
situation-room.pres-nothing-counted: Nothing counted yet. Each candidate’s two tests will fill in as results are published.
situation-room.pres-lede: The Constitution (s.134) elects the candidate who meets both tests. A test met now can be lost as more units report.
situation-room.pres-spread: 25% in two-thirds of the states + FCT
situation-room.pres-states-counted: {v0} of the 36 states and FCT have results counted
situation-room.pres-note-clear: The 36 states and the FCT make 37 units. 25 of them is a clear pass, since two-thirds of 37 is 24⅔. Exactly 24 is borderline: it is often called “24 states”, but no court has settled it.
situation-room.pres-note-fct: 25% in the FCT is not a separate test. The FCT counts as one of the 37 (Supreme Court, October 2023).
situation-room.pres-note-base: Shares are of valid votes. A state with nothing counted yet does not count towards the 25% test.
situation-room.pres-note-runoff: If no candidate meets both, INEC arranges a run-off within 21 days between the candidate with the most votes and the one with a majority in the most states.
situation-room.pres-note-inec: These are crowd-reported results. Only INEC’s declaration elects a President.
